subject: Governance & audit path: review of owners, evidence scope, and timeline
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial gap mapping for ISO/FedRAMP -> owners & artifacts

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Following our intake with QuantumBank this morning, I've pulled together a quick framing of questions we need to lock before the auditor pre-flight:

- Confirm control owners for ISO 27001 Annex A groups and FedRAMP-aligned controls (particularly encryption, key management, and logging).
- Identify any gaps where we can't produce live evidence (e.g., HSM attestation, retained snapshot windows).
- Agree on an evidence naming convention and shared Drive layout so ACME audit team can reference artifacts consistently.

I've attached a starter control_owner_matrix (WIP). Can you both review and mark owners by EOD Monday? QuantumBank expects a proposed sample window next week and ACME asked for a list of prioritized controls to validate first.

High-level asks: owner assignment, a short list of three high-priority artifacts we can ship first, and confirmation on whether the current HSM vendor has an SOC2/HSM attestation we can rely on.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T13:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial gap mapping for ISO/FedRAMP -> owners & artifacts

Thanks — looped in my notes inline and attached the KMS attestation we received last quarter. A few immediate items: 

1) HSM / KMS evidence: the attestation we have is vendor-supplied and does not include their FIPS 140-2 module validation copy. I've asked procurement to push HSMCorp for their FIPS validation and an updated attestation PDF. (attached: kms-attestation-20270518.pdf)

2) Evidence naming and retention: please endorse the suggested prefix "RDW-<control>-<YYYYMMDD>-<artifact_type>" so auditors don't have to guess. I've added an example layout to control_owner_matrix_v1.xlsx.

3) Snapshot windows: ACME asked for 90-day log retention samples and a 30-day configuration snapshot for the control sampling. If QuantumBank insists on a longer window we'll need to escalate to infra for extended log export (cost implications).

Marissa — can you confirm the owner for control set A.10 (cryptography) and whether the team can produce key rotation artifacts within two business days after owner is assigned?

I'll open a Procurement ticket for HSM validation and attach the SOW draft we're negotiating with HSMCorp (sow_redwood_hsm_draft.pdf).

Best,
Olga
Director, Information Security
Redwood Inference

From: Acme Security <auditor@acme-audit.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: QuantumBank SecOps <secops@quantumbank.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-21T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial gap mapping for ISO/FedRAMP -> owners & artifacts

Olga / Rishi,

Thanks for the draft. A couple of items from the audit side to help planning:

- For FedRAMP readiness we usually request live config snapshots and corresponding logs for the most recent 6 months for high-impact controls; if that's not feasible provide a 90-day window and we'll sample accordingly.
- For KMS/HSM, please provide the vendor attestation plus the FIPS module cert (or evidence of where it is hosted). If vendor cannot supply within 5 business days, we can accept a signed vendor statement with remediation timeline, but that will expand our sampling.
- Please include historical key rotation records (both automated and manual), and a brief narrative of rotation policy.

Proposed sample window: 2027-02-01 -> 2027-05-01 (we'll finalize after you assign owners).

If helpful, we can run a 2-hour pre-audit workshop next Thursday to align expectations — propose Thu 2027-05-27 10:00 PDT.

Regards,
Samira Khan
Engagement Lead, Acme Security

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Security <auditor@acme-audit.com>, QuantumBank SecOps <secops@quantumbank.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial gap mapping for ISO/FedRAMP -> owners & artifacts

All,

Thanks Samira — the proposed sample window is acceptable as a starting point. Quick operational updates:

- Procurement flagged a DocuSign SOW delay with HSMCorp (DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/sender/view?envelopeId=abc123). If that pushes past 2027-05-31 we will not have the FIPS proof in time and will need ACME to accept a vendor attestation + interim plan.
- Attached is an updated evidence catalog (evidence_catalog_v2.csv) with the three artifacts we can ship this week:
  1) RDW-CRYPTO-20270520-key-rotation-log.csv
  2) RDW-LOG-20270401-20270430-security-events.log.gz
  3) RDW-CONFIG-20270331-ec2-snap.txt

- I've created a Jira ticket to track the priority controls and owners: SEC-321 (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/SEC-321). Please add any additional artifacts to that ticket rather than creating new Drive folders.

Marissa: can you confirm ownership of the cryptography control set and whether your team can produce the rotation proof by Tuesday 2027-05-25? If not, propose an alternate owner or timeline so we can communicate to QuantumBank.

Rishi

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Security <auditor@acme-audit.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial gap mapping for ISO/FedRAMP -> owners & artifacts

Thanks — quick summary and owners/action items (finalizing today):

- Control assignment:
  * Cryptography (A.10 / FedRAMP SC-12 equivalent) -> Owner: Marissa Cole (action: produce key rotation logs, encryption config, rotation policy). DUE: 2027-05-25 17:00 PDT.
  * Logging & Monitoring -> Owner: Rishi Malhotra (action: provide 90-day log export + sampling README). DUE: 2027-05-27 12:00 PDT.
  * KMS/HSM attestation follow-up -> Owner: Olga Petrov (action: escalate procurement for FIPS cert and vendor attestation; provide interim vendor statement if needed). DUE: 2027-05-28 17:00 PDT.

- Artifacts to deliver this week (per evidence_catalog_v2): RDW-CRYPTO-20270520-key-rotation-log.csv, RDW-LOG-20270401-20270430-security-events.log.gz, RDW-CONFIG-20270331-ec2-snap.txt. All artifacts must be uploaded to the Drive folder linked here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cControlOwnerMatrix.

- Workshop: ACME pre-audit workshop confirmed for Thu 2027-05-27 10:00 PDT. Please prepare a 10-minute runbook walk and 15-minute Q&A on KMS controls.

If the HSM SOW (sow_redwood_hsm_draft.pdf) does not execute by 2027-05-31 we will document a compensating control and ask ACME to accept a signed vendor attestation with remediation milestones.

I'll update SEC-321 with the owner assignments and attach the control_owner_matrix_v1.xlsx version with inline notes. If anyone needs to reassign, reply-all with the proposed owner and justification.

Regards,
Olga
Director, Information Security
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments referenced: control_owner_matrix_v1.xlsx, kms-attestation-20270518.pdf, evidence_catalog_v2.csv, sow_redwood_hsm_draft.pdf
